note: Pocket Town data (W7). Generated once from the design notes; edit this file directly from now on. Reward numbers are intentionally small: the town flavors a run, it does not decide it.

buildings.name: Garden
buildings.blurb: Water and harvest berries that carry into your next run.

actions.name: Tend the berry beds
actions.desc: Plant a seed, water it, and harvest when it is ripe. Beds grow one stage each time you start a run.

actions.name: Tutorial garden
actions.desc: The Professor explains the game in a small hands-on lesson. Each lesson pays once.

options.label: Lesson 1: Catching
options.say: The Professor snaps a pretend ball at a scarecrow. "Lower its health first. Status helps too. Then throw."

options.label: Lesson 2: Types
options.say: Pots of fire, water and grass sit in a ring. "Each beats one and loses to one. Remember the ring."

options.label: Lesson 3: Care
options.say: You pat a watering can. "Bonded Pokémon crit more and endure more. Feed, groom, talk."

options.label: Lesson 4: Camp
options.say: A toy tent pops up. "Camp is where you cook, craft and rest. Spend a stop wisely."

options.label: Lesson 5: Luck
options.say: The Professor tips his hat. "Keep catching the same species and the shiny meter fills."

buildings.name: Training Dojo
buildings.blurb: Spar with a dummy, and test movesets without risk.

actions.name: Spar with the dummy
actions.desc: Time your strikes. Better rounds earn more practice.

miss.say: You flail at the dummy and hit your own toe.

ok.say: A tidy spar. The dummy wobbles.

good.say: Crisp hits! You pocket an X Attack.

actions.name: Practice dummy (moveset lab)
actions.desc: Pick a Pokémon from your last team and a move to see its damage against the dummy. No risk, no cost.

buildings.name: Library
buildings.blurb: Read lore books and take the quiz for rewards.

actions.name: Read a book
actions.desc: Lore books. The first read of each pays Research Points.

actions.name: Take the quiz
actions.desc: Three questions a day. Right answers pay.

buildings.name: Trophy Room
buildings.blurb: Your trophy shelf, and a rubbing minigame to polish them.

actions.name: Trophy shelf
actions.desc: Boss kills, champion wins and mastery, each on its own shelf.

actions.name: Polish a trophy
actions.desc: Rub in rhythm. A polished trophy shines brighter and earns a Shine point.

buildings.name: Bulletin Board
buildings.blurb: Pin contracts and weekly events so you see them first.

actions.name: Pin a contract
actions.desc: Pinned contracts stay on top of the board and in your Town header.

buildings.name: Mailbox
buildings.blurb: Letters from rivals, townsfolk and Pokémon.

actions.name: Open the mail
actions.desc: A new batch every day: rival notes, NPC letters, Pokémon scrawls. Some hold gifts.

buildings.name: Radio Tower
buildings.blurb: Tune a broadcast. Your next run starts with its gift.

actions.name: Tune a broadcast
actions.desc: One broadcast per run.

options.label: Weather Report
options.say: A calm voice reads the skies. You scribble the highlights.

reward.note: The radio promised clear skies when you set out.

options.label: Trainer Tips
options.say: "Always check your Bag before the gym." Wise words.

reward.note: A trainer tip crackled over the radio before you left.

options.label: Wild Watch
options.say: Static, then a list of spotted species.

reward.note: Wild Watch named a few species to look for.

options.label: Battle Hour
options.say: Two announcers shout over a match replay.

reward.note: Battle Hour left you pumped for the first fight.

options.label: Oldies Request
options.say: The old tune plays. You hum along.

reward.note: You hummed an old tune on the way out.

buildings.name: Kitchen
buildings.blurb: Prepare run snacks. Combine two ingredients and see what you get.

actions.name: Cook a snack
actions.desc: Pick two ingredients. Known recipes make a proper snack; unknown mixes make mush. One snack per run.

buildings.name: Workshop
buildings.blurb: Craft balls for credits. Gear tune-ups are in the in-run Camp.

actions.name: Craft balls
actions.desc: Turn credits into balls for the next run.

actions.name: Repair gear
actions.desc: Fix a keepsake so it is ready to carry. Also earns a tune-up charge that makes your first camp gadget repair free.

options.label: Tune up the toolkit
options.say: You oil every hinge and sharpen every blade.

reward.say: You pack two flasks of oil for the road.

buildings.name: Greenhouse
buildings.blurb: Raise plants that change as they grow, like Oddish bulbs.

actions.name: Tend the plants
actions.desc: Each run you start grows them one stage. Fully grown plants give stones and items.

yield.say: The Vileplume bloom gives up a Leaf Stone.
Sunflora leaves a Sun Stone in its petals.

buildings.name: Aquarium
buildings.blurb: Feed and decorate for Water-type bonds.

actions.name: Feed the tank
actions.desc: Fish grow a stage per run started. A well-fed tank adds Water-type bond gifts.

yield.say: Gyarados splashes you with a happy roar.
Goldeen spits a Water Stone out of the sand.

actions.name: Decorate the tank
actions.desc: Buy tank decor. More decor makes feeding a little more rewarding.

buildings.name: Observatory
buildings.blurb: Stargaze and choose an omen for your next run.

actions.name: Read the stars
actions.desc: One omen per run.

options.label: The Comet
options.say: A streak of white crosses the sky.

reward.note: A comet crossed the sky the night before you left.

options.label: The Full Moon
options.say: The moon sits fat and bright.

reward.note: The full moon watched you pack.

options.label: The Twins
options.say: Two stars burn side by side.

reward.note: The Twins hung low over the town.

options.label: The Hunter
options.say: Three stars line up like a belt.

reward.note: The Hunter rose red at your back.

options.label: The Lamp
options.say: A single steady star.

reward.note: The Lamp star burned steady.

buildings.name: Hot Spring
buildings.blurb: A bond-and-heal session between runs.

actions.name: Soak with your team
actions.desc: Hold steady until the steam is just right.

buildings.name: Fireplace
buildings.blurb: Sit with your last team. Each chat is a short vignette.

actions.name: Sit by the fire
actions.desc: Pick a Pokémon from your last team. Their chat depends on their type. The first chat with each species pays a little.

buildings.name: Arcade Corner
buildings.blurb: Mini versions of battle and rhythm modes, plus darts and Memory Match.

actions.name: Rhythm cabinet
actions.desc: Press on the beat.

perfect.say: All perfect! The cabinet lights up.

actions.name: Mini battle cabinet
actions.desc: Pick the best type against a foe. Three rounds a day.

actions.name: Darts
actions.desc: Hit the bullseye as the ring closes.

actions.name: Memory Match
actions.desc: Flip cards to find pairs of Pokémon. Fewer misses pay more.

buildings.name: Photo Studio
buildings.blurb: Backdrops and poses for team photos.

actions.name: Backdrop shop
actions.desc: Buy backdrops for your photos.

actions.name: Take a team photo
actions.desc: Choose a pose; the shot is saved to your album with the backdrop you wear.

options.label: Line up
options.say: Everyone lines up and smiles.

options.label: Dog pile
options.say: Somebody sits on somebody. Perfect.

options.label: Hero pose
options.say: Chins up. Capes (imaginary) flapping.

options.label: Sleepy pile
options.say: A very quiet photo.

actions.name: Pick a backdrop
actions.desc: Wear a backdrop you own.

buildings.name: Dressing Mirror
buildings.blurb: Outfits with a twirl, tailored at the costume shop.

actions.name: Try an outfit
actions.desc: Pick an outfit you own. The mirror twirls you around.

actions.name: Measure up at the tailor
actions.desc: Stand still while the tailor measures. A better fit unlocks the next outfit.

miss.say: The tape snaps back. Try again later.

actions.name: Costume contest
actions.desc: Show off your outfit. NPC judges vote; more outfits owned means more votes.

buildings.name: Pet Corner
buildings.blurb: Your past Pokémon roam here. Play with them.

actions.name: Play with a pet
actions.desc: Pick one of your pets. Playing daily builds a bond; at the bond mark they give a gift.

buildings.name: Gym Replica
buildings.blurb: Practice against ghost data of opponents who beat you.

actions.name: Practice match
actions.desc: Your last team against a ghost opponent, scored with real type and level numbers. No risk.

actions.name: Mirror Room
actions.desc: Meet a ghost of your last winning or losing team and spar with it.

ok.say: You match your ghost move for move.

buildings.name: Relic Museum
buildings.blurb: Place found relics on pedestals; matching sets unlock bonuses.

actions.name: Place a relic
actions.desc: Relics you found in past runs. Three pedestals; each tier you fill adds a start-of-run bonus.

buildings.name: Daycare
buildings.blurb: Leave a Pokémon, collect eggs with surprising parentage.

actions.name: Leave a Pokémon
actions.desc: Pick from your last team. After two runs the pair-up yields an egg-gift of mixed parentage.

actions.name: Collect from the Daycare
actions.desc: Ready after two runs. Mixed-parentage eggs come as items.

options.label: Collect the egg
options.say: The caretaker beams. "Look who has your eyes."

reward.say: You collect a Lucky Egg and spare balls.

buildings.name: Stage
buildings.blurb: Perform contests to win ribbons.

actions.name: Perform a contest
actions.desc: Pick a category and a team member. Good performances win ribbons.

buildings.name: Cinema
buildings.blurb: Rewatch your best battles and endings.

actions.name: Rewatch a run
actions.desc: Choose a finished run and relive its top moments as a short reel.

actions.name: Cutscene theatre
actions.desc: Replay endings and rival arcs you have seen.

buildings.name: Bakery
buildings.blurb: Baked goods give pre-run buffs. Ding at the right moment.

actions.name: Bake a batch
actions.desc: Take the tray out when the oven dings.

miss.say: Burnt crisps. Not even the Pokémon want them.

perfect.say: A bake worthy of a champion.

buildings.name: Tea Room
buildings.blurb: Pour tea for a guest and hear a secret.

actions.name: Pour the tea
actions.desc: Steady hands earn a secret. Secrets are kept in your Guest Book.

miss.say: You spill it. The guest sighs and leaves.

ok.say: The guest sips and smiles, but says little.

perfect.say: A perfect cup. The guest tells you everything.

buildings.name: Rooftop
buildings.blurb: Watch the weather forecast and choose a lucky charm.

actions.name: Read the forecast
actions.desc: A forecast seeded by the date. Cosmetic only.

actions.name: Choose a lucky charm
actions.desc: One charm per run.

options.label: Four-leaf clover
options.say: You tuck the clover in your cap.

reward.note: You carried a pressed clover for luck.

options.label: Pidgey feather
options.say: A brown feather, soft and light.

reward.note: A Pidgey feather rode in your cap.

options.label: Smooth pebble
options.say: Warm from the sun.

reward.note: A smooth pebble sat warm in your pocket.

options.label: Little bell
options.say: It rings, soft and clear.

reward.note: A little bell chimed in your bag.

buildings.name: Basement
buildings.blurb: A secret door opens when you play the right code of Pokémon cries.

actions.name: Enter the cry code
actions.desc: Listen to the cries, then repeat the order. A new code appears after each opened vault.

buildings.name: Wall of Fame
buildings.blurb: Sign the wall with a graffiti stylus.

actions.name: Sign the wall
actions.desc: One signature per win, plus one just for visiting. Pick a color and a stamp.

buildings.name: Wishing Tree
buildings.blurb: Hang tags that give the next run flavor. They never change a roll.

actions.name: Hang a tag
actions.desc: Up to three tags hang at once; they are read in the run journal.

options.label: A calm sea
options.say: The tag swings in the breeze.

reward.note: Wish: a calm sea.

options.label: A worthy rival
options.say: The tag glows faintly.

reward.note: Wish: a worthy rival.

options.label: A new friend
options.say: The tag rustles.

reward.note: Wish: a new friend.

options.label: One good storm
options.say: The tag flaps.

reward.note: Wish: one good storm.

options.label: A safe way home
options.say: The tag settles.

reward.note: Wish: a safe way home.

options.label: Something shiny
options.say: The tag sparkles, just for a moment.

reward.note: Wish: something shiny.

buildings.name: Shrine
buildings.blurb: Offer relics for blessings, and cleanse cursed items.

actions.name: Offer a relic
actions.desc: Relics from past runs. A cursed relic offered here earns Shrine Water, which cleanses a cursed relic for free at camp.

actions.name: Receive a blessing
actions.desc: Spend an offering for a blessing on the next run.

options.label: Blessing of the Road
options.say: A warm breeze follows you out.

reward.note: The Shrine blessed your road.

options.label: Blessing of the Hearth
options.say: You feel rested.

reward.note: The Shrine blessed your hearth.

options.label: Shrine Water
options.desc: Needs 1 offering. Cleanses a cursed relic for free.
options.say: A bottle of clear water, cool in your palm.

reward.say: You pack a bottle of Shrine Water.

actions.name: Buy Shrine Water
actions.desc: No relic to spare? A priest sells a bottle for credits.

goods.label: Shrine Water
goods.desc: Cleanses one cursed relic at camp.

buildings.name: Pond
buildings.blurb: Skip stones for tiny luck, and fish for the pond log.

actions.name: Skip stones
actions.desc: Release as the ring closes. Each skip adds a coin of luck.

perfect.say: Seven skips! A little luck rubs off.

actions.name: Fish in the pond
actions.desc: Reel in the moment you feel the tug.

buildings.name: Meowth Café
buildings.blurb: Meowth-line staff pay coins for chores. Spend them on treats.

actions.name: Do a chore
actions.desc: Sweep to the beat. Coins are paid by the Meowth.

actions.name: Order a treat
actions.desc: Spend café coins.

options.label: Oran latte
options.say: Sweet and warm.

options.label: Persian cake
options.say: It is a very fluffy cake.

options.label: Pay Day special
options.say: The Meowth winks. Pay Day.

buildings.name: Town Square
buildings.blurb: Every building bounces when you step in. The sky mirrors your last run, and pets follow your cursor.

actions.name: Look around
actions.desc: Weather mirrors the last run (sun after a win, a storm after a defeat). Your pets trot after the cursor, and the Decor switch lets you drag furniture.

buildings.name: Seasonal Corner
buildings.blurb: The Hub swaps with the season and gets an interaction prop.

actions.name: Visit the seasonal prop
actions.desc: Snowman, cherry blossoms, sunflowers or pumpkins, depending on the real month. One visit a day.

buildings.name: Night Garden
buildings.blurb: After dark the Hub fills with fireflies. Catch them for tiny gifts.

actions.name: Catch a firefly
actions.desc: Only at night (local time 8 pm to 6 am). Tap as the ring closes.

perfect.say: It leaves a trail of light on your hand.

buildings.name: Developer Room
buildings.blurb: A passage under the bed. The jokes are bad on purpose.

actions.name: Read the whiteboard
actions.desc: A new joke every visit. The first one pays Research Points.

needs.text: Visit the Town 20 times to find the passage under the bed.

buildings.name: Statue Vault
buildings.blurb: Turn four statues to face the right way and the vault opens.

actions.name: Turn a statue
actions.desc: Each statue has four facings. The plaque gives a hint about the right ones.

buildings.name: Elevator
buildings.blurb: A panel of floor buttons, each showing a mini scene.

actions.name: Press a floor button
actions.desc: Floors open as you visit buildings.

buildings.name: Time Machine
buildings.blurb: Replay a past run and imagine a different choice.

actions.name: What if?
actions.desc: Pick a past run and a different choice. See how it might have gone (a story only; nothing about the old run changes).

buildings.name: Hub Phone
buildings.blurb: Call NPCs for chat and favors.

actions.name: Make a call
actions.desc: One favor per contact per day.

options.label: Mom
options.say: "Eat something green, dear." She mails a snack.

options.label: The Professor
options.say: "Excellent! Send me a photo of anything strange."

options.label: Nurse Joy
options.say: "Please remember to heal your team!" She mails a Potion.

options.label: The Clerk
options.say: "A coupon for you."

options.label: Your rival
options.say: "Still training?" They hang up before you answer.

options.label: The Sage
options.say: "The shrine remembers." Static.

buildings.name: Lost & Found
buildings.blurb: Items you left behind at the end of runs return here.

actions.name: Claim a lost item
actions.desc: Pick up what the last runs left behind. It rides with you next run.

buildings.name: Guestbook
buildings.blurb: Records past visitors from your friends' ghost data and your own trainers.

actions.name: Read the guestbook
actions.desc: Ghosts you imported from friends sign in here with their result.

buildings.name: Furniture Shop
buildings.blurb: Decorate your room, then drag the pieces anywhere.

actions.name: Buy furniture
actions.desc: Credits for furniture. Pieces from achievements are free.

goods.label: Crown pillow
goods.desc: Free once you have a victory.

actions.name: Arrange the room
actions.desc: Pick a piece and place it. In the Town, switch on Decor mode to drag pieces anywhere.

buildings.name: Capsule Corner
buildings.blurb: A gacha capsule machine for cosmetics. Tap and wiggle the capsule to open it.

actions.name: Turn the crank
actions.desc: One capsule costs credits (the first of each day is free). Duplicates turn into Research Points. A rare or better always drops within ten pulls.

buildings.name: Jukebox
buildings.blurb: Every unlocked track. Tracks unlock with progress.

actions.name: Play a track
actions.desc: Pick any unlocked track. Listening is free.

buildings.name: Town Hall
buildings.blurb: Stats, run history, quests, the season track and the collection book.

actions.name: Statistics
actions.desc: Total runs, best streak, favourite type and more.

actions.name: Run ledger
actions.desc: Every run with filters and sorting. Copy a run's seed to try it again.

actions.name: Townsfolk roster
actions.desc: Townsfolk who move in as you earn achievements.

actions.name: Daily quest board
actions.desc: Three quests a day by your local date, offline. Each pays when its action is done.

actions.name: Daily mystery gift
actions.desc: An envelope every day, by weekday. Streaks add a bonus.

actions.name: Season track
actions.desc: A free, offline progress track. Town actions and runs earn track points.

actions.name: Collection book
actions.desc: Badges, ribbons, stickers, trading cards and more.

actions.name: Badge case
actions.desc: Equip up to three gym badges; each gives a small perk every run.

actions.name: Cursor trails
actions.desc: Cosmetic trails for the cursor. Unlock them in capsules and the track.

lore.title: The Ring of Types
lore.text: Every type beats one and falls to another, like a ring around a campfire. Learn the ring and half the road is easy.

lore.title: On Bonds
lore.text: A Pokémon who trusts you will take a hit meant for itself. Feed them, name them, and sit by the fire.

lore.title: A Trainer's Atlas
lore.text: Each region has eight gyms, a League and a champion who has seen a thousand trainers fall.

lore.title: The Camper's Handbook
lore.text: A good camp is a pot, a bench, a bell and a quiet hour. Many runs are won before the first battle of the day.

lore.title: Glitter and Luck
lore.text: Shiny Pokémon are rare by design. Patience lights the meter faster than hope.

lore.title: A History of Rivals
lore.text: Rivals are not enemies. They are mirrors that win the days you lose.

lore.title: Relics and Curses
lore.text: The old relics give power and ask a price. The Shrine will take the price, if you bring a gift.

lore.title: Raid Etiquette
lore.text: Bring balance, bring berries, and do not stand in the red circle.

lore.title: Eggs and Daycare
lore.text: An egg remembers both parents. Sometimes it remembers more than they do.

lore.title: The Night Garden
lore.text: After dark the fireflies come out. They only ever land on people who stand still.

guests.secret: Some wild Pokémon only show up after you have lost a battle at sea.
A Revive in the Bag is worth three Potions when the last fight goes wrong.
Rivals remember how you won, not only that you did.
The back-alley relic is risky, but cursed relics wash clean at the Shrine.
If you stand very still in the Night Garden, a firefly lands on your hat.
Every vault has a different door code. Listen to the cries.
Research Points are cheaper to earn by trying new things than by repeating old ones.
The café pays more on days you are on time.

normal: {name} stretches out on the rug and yawns. It is a good day to do nothing.
fire: {name} warms its paws on the fire and the whole room gets cosier.
water: {name} watches the flames hiss against a spilled cup and looks very smug.
grass: {name} sways to the crackling, a small leaf unfurling on its head.
electric: {name} sparks a static cat's cradle across the rug. Everyone ducks.
ice: {name} sits just far enough from the fire to keep a little frost on its back.
fighting: {name} does one lazy push-up beside the fireplace, then falls asleep mid-set.
poison: {name} bubbles a quiet, happy purple stew in the corner. Nobody asks.
ground: {name} digs a cosy hollow beside the hearth and settles in.
flying: {name} fluffs its wings and perches on the mantel to guard the fire.
psychic: {name} stares at the flames and sees something nobody else can.
bug: {name} hums softly and a moth drifts in from nowhere to join it.
rock: {name} soaks up the warmth like a sun-baked boulder.
ghost: {name} drifts through the smoke, turning the shadows into shapes.
dragon: {name} curls around the hearth, one eye open, humming like a kettle.
dark: {name} sits just outside the firelight, close enough to feel it.
steel: {name} gleams orange in the glow and clinks softly when it breathes.
fairy: {name} dances once around the fireplace and sprinkles sparkles on the logs.
default: {name} curls up by the fire and sighs happily.

letters.text: Remember to eat and sleep. I put a berry in the envelope.
Your notes are the best in the lab. Keep photographing strange things.
Storms over the bay again. Be careful at sea.
A coupon for the shop. Do not spend it all in one place.
Pika pika! (This is a drawing of you. You are very tall in it.)
Squeak. (There is a crayon smear.) Squeak squeak.
Please remember to rest your team. Enclosed: a Potion.
I saw you on the board! I cannot wait to see your next run.
The forest is quiet this year. I think they are waiting for you.
Zzzz. (It signed with a paw print.)

seasons.name: Winter
seasons.tap: You roll a snowball into a snowman. It wears your scarf for a moment.

seasons.name: Spring
seasons.tap: Cherry petals fall into your open hands.

reward.say: The blossom brings a little luck: +1 Research Point.

seasons.name: Summer
seasons.tap: The sunflower turns to face you and drops a seed.

reward.say: The sunflower drops two seeds that grow into Oran Berries.

seasons.name: Autumn
seasons.tap: You jump in a heap of leaves and find a coin.

seasons.name: Halloween
seasons.tap: The pumpkin grins. A ghostly hand drops a treat.

reward.say: Trick or treat! A Super Potion.

dailyGifts.say: A coin purse: ₽200 at the start of your next run.
Sunday special: Great Balls and a Revive.

dailyQuests.text: Do a chore at the café

floors.name: Lobby
floors.scene: A marble lobby, a potted fern, a ding of the bell.

floors.name: Roof garden
floors.scene: Raised beds in the sun. Something is growing.

floors.name: Library floor
floors.scene: Towering shelves. A librarian shushes you from three floors up.

floors.name: Arcade floor
floors.scene: Cabinets flicker. Somewhere a Pikachu is winning.

floors.name: Spa floor

floors.name: Kitchen floor

floors.name: Stage floor

Taped under the desk: a map labelled "Here be seeds".

reward.say: A spicy pie that wakes you up.

A rice ball and a little extra.
